name: komdosh-dev-infra-k8s
description: Kubernetes manifest authoring, security hardening, workload troubleshooting, and ArgoCD GitOps delivery. Ships three agents — k8s-author (hardened Deployments/StatefulSets, Kustomize overlays, Helm values, all three probes, PDB, topology spread, graceful shutdown; plus ArgoCD Application/ApplicationSet/AppProject with pinned prod revisions, scoped projects, prune+selfHeal, sync waves), the read-only k8s-auditor (Pod Security Standards restricted + resource discipline + reliability on the rendered manifests, plus GitOps hygiene — moving prod revisions, default projects, inline secrets, drift-hiding ignoreDifferences), and the read-only k8s-diagnostician (root-cause diagnosis of CrashLoopBackOff / ImagePullBackOff / OOMKilled / Pending / probe failures, and of OutOfSync / Degraded / stuck-Progressing / drifting apps — separating sync status from health status). Four skills: discover-k8s-workloads, probe-cluster-state, discover-argocd-apps, probe-app-health. Five rules: k8s-manifests, k8s-security, k8s-resources, argocd-applications, gitops-delivery. Six commands: /k8s-manifest, /k8s-audit, /k8s-debug, /argo-app, /argo-audit, /argo-diagnose. Never mutates a cluster and never syncs out of band — rollback is git revert. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
